subject.declared_domain: The C1 rung of the C0..C4 system ladder: INTERACTIONS -- the typed directed edges over C0 facts. The canon declares it as 'INTERACTIONS ~40k EDGES: the 10 relations (produces, consumes, derives-from, depends-on, contains, triggers, guards, governs, denies, owns)' and marks it VIEW-COMPILED. The declared domain is therefore the RELATION vocabulary; the live artifact is an edge_type population, and this card measures the distance between them.

methodology.how: C1 is view-compiled by the same globgrph derive runner that produces C0. Each discovered relationship between two node_ids is materialized as a row in the Iceberg table graph_edges carrying source, target and edge_type, then projected into kuzu_nessie_db alongside the nodes. As with C0, the producer ORIGINATES the physical edge_type vocabulary (53 distinct values live) while the rule bank DECLARES a relation vocabulary of 10 relations plus 3 composites; a further 8 physical edge types are explicitly declared NON-relations, and a frontend-scoped adapter binds 11 more. Nothing joins the remaining 31.
composes: NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK.yaml#non_relation_edges -- 8 physical edge types declared NOT to be relations
NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK.yaml#c1_frontend_adapter -- 11 frontend edge types bound to existing relations

cadence.declared_rhythm: nightly 02:00Z full re-derive, plus a continuous event-driven CloudTrail incremental
cadence.actual_trigger: EventBridge rule opal-globgrph-derive-runner-nightly, cron(0 2 * * ? *), ENABLED -- and EventBridge rule opal-globgrph-cloudtrail-mgmt, ScheduleExpression None (event pattern), ENABLED. Both measured on the LIVE events plane; the scheduler plane carries no C1 producer.
cadence.live_instance_age: graph_edges table last-write 16.1h before read, against a declared <26h cadence marker. The sibling graph_nodes table last-wrote 5.1h before read against a <6h marker. The two tables therefore refresh on DIFFERENT effective cadences and carry different declared bands.
cadence.evidence: BOTH TRIGGER PLANES SWEPT. Events plane: aws events list-rules, paginated and materialized client-side (NOT --query length(), which returns the PAGE count) -> opal-globgrph-derive-runner-nightly cron(0 2 * * ? *) ENABLED; opal-globgrph-cloudtrail-mgmt None ENABLED. Scheduler plane: aws scheduler list-schedules -> 18 total, only globgrph-cse-producer-nightly is graph-adjacent and it is a downstream cse producer, not the C1 derive. Terraform corroboration infra/aws/terraform/globgrph/item2a.tf:439 @d89cc4fc9c. Ages read from the comp-kuzu provenance header at card time. A FINDING SITS INSIDE THIS ROW, and it is why the two ages are quoted together rather than separately: the provenance header states that graph_nodes is written by TWO producers -- the 02:00Z full re-derive AND the event-driven CloudTrail incremental -- while graph_edges carries the slower <26h band. An incremental that adds a node without adding its edges leaves the edge set lagging its own endpoints, and nothing in a query result discloses that skew. This lane MEASURED the two ages and the two declared bands; it did NOT exercise an incremental write and watch an edge lag, so the skew is a measured STRUCTURAL possibility, not an observed instance.

coverage.universe: Every typed directed relationship the derive runner discovers between two C0 nodes, across the BACKEND, FRONTEND and KNOWLEDGE substrate sides.
coverage.denominator: 58,224 of 58,224 edges carry a non-null edge_type (53 distinct types) -- zero untyped. Against the FULL declared name universe of 32 (10 relations + 3 composites + 8 non_relation_edges + 11 frontend-adapter determinations): 22 of 53 edge_types are named, 31 of 53 are not. By volume: 37,521 of 58,224 edges (64.4%) carry a declared name, 20,703 of 58,224 (35.6%) do not.
explicitly_out: 8 physical edge types declared NON-relations in NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK.yaml#non_relation_edges -- DECLARES, ENCRYPTS_WITH, HAS_TYPE, INSTANTIATES, IS_ENDPOINT, MONITORS, REFERENCES_TYPE, SHARES_SOURCE. These are deliberately outside the relation vocabulary rather than missed, which is what makes them readable.

the 31 live edge_types named nowhere: ASSUMES, CALLS, CAN_ASSUME, CLUSTERS, CONTAINS_DRILLDOWN, EMITS_TO, FETCHES, FLOWS_TO, HAS_FIELD, HAS_KEY, HAS_POLICY, HAS_PROFILE, HAS_PROP, HAS_PROPS_TYPE, HAS_ROUTE, INVOKES, ORIGIN, OWNED_BY, PROJECTS_TO, PUBLISHES_TO, READS, READS_FIELD, READS_S3, READS_SECRET, READS_URL, RUNS, SERVED_FROM, USES_LAYER, USES_OAI, WRITES, WRITES_S3 -- NOT declared out, merely unbound, which is a different thing and is the finding
coverage.evidence: Census computed from the materialized comp-kuzu result set joined in python against NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK.yaml @5fc45ad69d. Untyped control: 'MATCH ()-[e]->() WHERE e.edge_type IS NULL RETURN count(e)' -> 0 against 'MATCH ()-[e]->() RETURN count(e)' -> 58,224, so the 53-type census spans the whole population. A METHOD ERROR WAS CAUGHT AND CORRECTED INSIDE THIS ROW: the first census was read through 'tail -50', which silently discarded the HIGHEST-count rows and made the visible types sum to roughly 14,000 against a known 58,224 -- a well-formed answer about a truncated population. Re-run with an explicit ORDER BY / LIMIT from the head, the top types are CONTAINS 29,271, OWNED_BY 6,261, HAS_FIELD 4,269, RENDERS 2,447, READS_FIELD 2,110, CALLS 1,623. The single relation CONTAINS carries 29,271 of 58,224 edges (50.3%), so the 64.4% mapped figure is dominated by one edge type and should not be read as broad vocabulary coverage. key.identity_space: An edge is identified by the triple (source node_id, edge_type, target node_id). Both endpoints live in the C0 heterogeneous node_id space (ARNs, repo paths, S3 key globs, synthetic motif ids), so C1 inherits C0's identity problems in both endpoint positions and adds edge_type as a third component.
key.declared_mapping: org/modules/graph/NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK.yaml @5fc45ad69d -- PARTIAL and assembled from three separate blocks (#relations + #relation_composites + #non_relation_edges) plus a fourth, #c1_frontend_adapter, which is FRONTEND-SCOPED. There is no single estate-wide edge_type-to-relation map; 31 of 53 live edge_types are bound by none of the four.
key.evidence: Overlap computed against all four declared blocks read at NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK.yaml @5fc45ad69d. TWO SCOPE FACTS THAT MUST TRAVEL WITH THE NUMBERS, because omitting either manufactures a drift claim this lane did NOT measure. First: #c1_frontend_adapter carries its own denominator on its face -- '11 unmapped live edge types / 3912 edges (comp-kuzu @2026-07-23T14:52Z, HEAD current)' with verdict '11/11 bind to an existing relation additively; 0/11 require a new ratified relation'. Second: that adapter is FRONTEND-scoped by its own name and content, while this card's 31-of-53 / 20,703-edge figure is ESTATE-WIDE at 2026-08-26. THESE ARE DIFFERENT POPULATIONS AT DIFFERENT VINTAGES AND THIS CARD DOES NOT CALL THE DIFFERENCE DRIFT -- subtracting 11 from 31 to claim '20 new unbound types' would be exactly the residual-as-measurement error, since the two counts never spanned the same set. What IS measured: no estate-wide adapter exists, and 31 of 53 live edge_types carrying 20,703 of 58,224 edges are bound by no declared block at this vintage. key_is_stable IS 'unknown' AND WAS NOT EXERCISED: an edge key inherits both endpoints' stability and this lane did not exercise a rename in either position.

failure_mode.returns_on_failure: Identical to C0, because C1 is read through the same projection: a PROPERTY-plane error is LOUD (a misspelled property raises 'Binder exception: Cannot find property ... for n' and returns no count), while a VALUE-plane miss is SILENT and returns a clean, instant, well-formed 0 that is byte-identical to a genuine negative.
silent_degrade_paths: a stale kuzu projection answers every traversal cleanly at its own frozen vintage
an edge_type renamed upstream returns 0 under its old name with no signal that the name moved

the graph_nodes / graph_edges cadence skew (<6h vs <26h declared bands; 5.1h vs 16.1h observed) means a traversal can return a node whose edges have not yet been rebuilt -- a smaller, cleaner, entirely well-formed answer
the 20,703 edges (35.6%) under unbound edge_types are invisible to any relation-keyed traversal, which returns a confident smaller result rather than an error

an edge whose endpoint node_id changed shape (repo path rename) dangles or silently re-targets; the producer carries an explicit idempotent guard for one known instance of this class at derive_runner.py:1635 (_strip_c1_ladder_prefix), which is evidence the class is real and has been hit
failure_mode.evidence: EXERCISED with the same four-arm battery used for C0, run as separate invocations. ARM 3 is the C1-specific arm: nonexistent edge_type ZZZ_NO_SUCH_EDGE_9999 -> clean 0. ARM 1 (genuine negative, real node_type + nonexistent node_id) -> 0, byte-identical. ARM 4 (misspelled property) -> loud Binder exception, which establishes the instrument CAN fail loudly and so the zeros are answers rather than a dead probe. The dangling-endpoint path is not hypothetical: the producer source at infra/aws/globgrph/derive_runner.py:1635-1645 @ec0408628a carries a belt-and-suspenders guard whose own docstring says a stray ladder-form target would otherwise dangle rather than co-key -- this lane read that guard, it did not exercise it.
failure_mode.owner: 0.4.0_DE_ClientPlatform (producer); UNOWNED for the value-plane indistinguishability itself

verdict.why: All seven rows are worked with basis, evidence and owner; none is blank or guessed, so this is not INCOMPLETE. C1 is usable within limits, and the limits are wider than C0's. Four measured defects bound it: (1) 31 of 53 live edge_types, carrying 20,703 of 58,224 edges (35.6%), are bound by no declared block -- so any relation-keyed claim about C1 covers at most 64.4% of the edge population; (2) that 64.4% is dominated by a single edge type, CONTAINS at 29,271 of 58,224 edges (50.3%), so vocabulary coverage is far thinner than the volume figure suggests and the two must be quoted together; (3) the value-plane failure mode is indistinguishable from a genuine negative, exercised over four arms; (4) graph_nodes and graph_edges carry different declared cadence bands (<6h vs <26h) and were observed at different ages (5.1h vs 16.1h), so an edge set can lag its own endpoints with nothing in a query result disclosing the skew. None blocks use outright, but (1) and (2) together mean C1 should NOT be treated as a complete relation-typed interaction layer today. NOT CLAIMED: that the 22 mapped edge_types are mapped CORRECTLY, or that the cadence skew has produced an actual lagging edge -- this card measured the bands and the ages, not an instance.
